cultural.vision_reason: A printed cloth amulet depicting the Phra Chinarat Buddha (a famous Thai Buddha image) with Thai and Chinese text and yantra diagrams, worn/used as a protective ritual object in Thai Buddhist practice — this is a ritual amulet, not jewelry in the ornamental sense.

physical.title: amulet; yantra
physical.summary: Yellow printed cloth amulet. Cloth amulet printed with an image of the Phra Chinarat Buddha statue flanked by two female bodhisattvas (enlightened beings) wearing Chinese dress and with halos around their heads. The Buddha image is seated and framed within a decorated frame. Below him is Thai text including the name of the image and a recitation for honoring it. At the top, sides and bottom are the name of the image and monastery and wishes for well-being in Chinese. In the lower section are magic diagrams. The whole is bordered by a flower motif.
